Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.EZ2KdxVrJJdc1UGo]{Anima Ability: Wicked Wiles}

You use guile, glitter and explosive fey magics to draw someone’s attention and disappear. Select a point within the spell’s area. Creatures who are in the spell’s area see a distracting eruption of colors or hear a loud enchanting melody coming from the point, and are compelled to look. If you create a display of colors, this spell gains the visual trait, and if you create a melody this spell gains the auditory trait. Affected creatures must succeed on a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the display for 1 round. As part of casting this spell, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, using your anima attack modifier if it is higher than your Deception modifier. You automatically succeed against creatures who critically failed their saving throw.
